body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> CSJ Global(www.csjglobal.com) is getting attention of visitors at CES 2008 with its IP set-top box ‘Walk-TV’ supporting worldwide TV service.

As the most noticeable product of the company at CES 2008, the Walk-TV integrates a TV receiver and an external hard disk into an IP set-top box which includes recorder function. It enables you to watch any TV program of local region where it is installed.

Especially, it features a decoder that allows you to watch the programs on existing TV with a remote control as well as on a PC. It also supports features of a recorder such as rewind, fast forward and tracking controls and it could be utilized as a home monitoring device compatible with a camera.
Additionally, webhard function is available and two-way video conference call is also possible in case the Walk-TV belongs to each user.

Lim Yu, Global Marketing Chief of this company, said “The Walk-TV was developed for home entertainment market and now we are focusing on global promotion of it,” and “it took people’s interest as it is the only IP set-top box supporting from network PVR recording to home monitoring,” he mentioned.
“New ’GX550’, which received good reaction from Japanese hotel market, is also expected to be a good platform for us to make inroads into US hotel market,” he added.

Meanwhile, CSJ Global became renowned after developing IPTV set-top box ‘GX500’ for hotel and around 20,000 units of it have been already exported to hotel market, mainly in Japan. In this year, the company expects additional exportation of 100,000 units of GX550, a new version of the GX500, employing TV tuner and hard disk.
